items.title: Consumers find new ways to spend without selling positions
items.summary: Selling a stock position to raise cash has long been the default move. A growing share of consumers are skipping that step.

items.title: Finance Experts Reveal Lessons for Investors
items.summary: In a world of 24/7 trading, options and investing apps, Charles Schwab Chief Investment Strategist Liz Ann Sonders and Council on Foreign Relations Senior Fellow Rebecca Patterson join Bloomberg Open Interest to talk about their new book, "Investment Wisdom for Our Friends and Loved Ones: Timeless Lessons from Today's Top Finance Experts." They share timeless advice: start early, harness the power of compounding, and know the difference between investing and gambling.

items.title: 3 US Brokerage Stocks Investors Are Watching As Higher Rates Lift Cash Income
items.summary: Inflation is back in the spotlight, the Federal Reserve is leaning harder on interest rates, and cash is suddenly more than just a buffer in your brokerage account. Higher short term yields are reshaping how platforms, fintechs, and asset managers treat idle balances, and that can reward some stocks while leaving others behind. items.title: How Much Does a Bitcoin ATM Charge You to Buy $100 of Bitcoin?
items.summary: One reporter fed a crypto kiosk a $20 bill and walked away with far less Bitcoin than expected. Before you hand cash to one of these machines, see which hidden charges take the biggest bite and what cheaper routes exist.
